raw_narrative: Partial loss of returns (45 bbl/hr) while drilling permeable Tipam Sandstone at 1820m. Mud weight 10.2 ppg, ECD 10.8 ppg exceeded formation fracture gradient.
mitigation_description: Pill of 30 bbl medium Nut Plug (25 ppb) spotted across loss zone. Flow rate reduced from 2200 to 1750 lpm.
outcome: Losses slowed to 3 bbl/hr. Resumed controlled drilling with 9.8 ppg mud.
lesson_learned: Pre-treat active system with 15 ppb fibrous LCM prior to penetrating high-permeability Tipam sands.

raw_narrative: Severe seepage loss transitioning into total lost circulation (110 bbl/hr) at 3110m in cavernous Sylhet Limestone. Pit level dropped 65 bbl in 20 min.
mitigation_description: Pulled bit into 9-5/8 casing shoe. Mixed and pumped 50 bbl high-fluid-loss crosslinked gel LCM squeeze followed by 20 bbl cement plug.
outcome: Waited on cement 6 hrs. Tagged top of firm cement at 3095m. Drilled out with full returns.
lesson_learned: Sylhet Limestone karstification requires managed pressure drilling (MPD) or pre-positioned crosslinked polymer pills.

raw_narrative: Seepage losses of 22 bbl/hr observed in Tipam Sandstone interval. Static losses 8 bbl/hr.
mitigation_description: Added 20 ppb calcium carbonate (fine/medium grind) to active pit system and reduced pump strokes.
lesson_learned: Maintaining optimized particle size distribution (PSD) prevents seepage in depleted Tipam reservoirs.

raw_narrative: Loss of 50 bbl/hr encountered in micro-fractured Kopili formation at 2720m under 11.4 ppg mud.
mitigation_description: Spotted 40 bbl combo pill (flaked calcium carbonate + cellulosic fiber) and pulled off bottom.
outcome: Returns established at 1400 lpm with zero pit loss.
lesson_learned: ECD spikes during connections must be managed with surge/swab velocity controls.

raw_narrative: Dynamic mud loss of 28 bbl/hr while reaming at 1860m.
mitigation_description: Pill of mica and nutshell spotted; mud weight cut from 10.1 to 9.7 ppg.
lesson_learned: Monitor shale shaker screens for early indication of lost returns.

raw_narrative: Loss of 65 bbl/hr entered naturally fractured limestone at 2980m.
mitigation_description: Pumped engineered thixotropic cement spacer and 30 bbl calcium carbonate pill.
outcome: Hole packed off and healed; returned to drilling.
lesson_learned: Drill Sylhet formation with lower flow rate and continuous monitoring of Coriolis meter.

raw_narrative: Pit volume decreased by 18 bbl over 45 minutes in upper Tipam Sandstone.
mitigation_description: Added fine marble LCM to suction tank.
lesson_learned: Keep fine marble LCM pre-mixed in slug pit when drilling sand packages.

raw_narrative: Bedding plane losses of 55 bbl/hr in Kopili transition zone at 2840m.
mitigation_description: Spotted diatomaceous earth blend pill across open fractures.
outcome: Loss rate dropped below 2 bbl/hr. Continued drilling ahead.
lesson_learned: Carefully manage pipe trip speeds to prevent swab-induced pressure drops.

raw_narrative: Sudden drop in flow-out percentage from 100% to 15% (loss rate ~90 bbl/hr) upon penetration of vugular Sylhet Limestone at 3050m.
mitigation_description: Pumped two consecutive 35 bbl coarse Nut Plug / Mica pills followed by balanced cement plug.
outcome: Well bore stabilized; full circulation regained at 1600 lpm.
lesson_learned: Offset wells in Sylhet Limestone have extensive fault-associated fracture swarms.

raw_narrative: Loss of returns averaging 32 bbl/hr at 1890m in porous Tipam channel sand.
mitigation_description: Treated system with 25 ppb blended fibrous LCM.
lesson_learned: Monitor fluid temperature: thermal thinning contributed to increased loss.

raw_narrative: Severe rotary torque oscillations between 12 and 34 kN-m with stick-slip index jumping to 0.88 at 2240m in Barail Coal-Shale. RPM dropped from 120 to 45.
mitigation_description: Picked up off bottom, pumped 25 bbl lubricity pill (glycol blend), reduced WOB from 130 to 80 kN, and increased RPM to 140.
outcome: Torque smoothed to 14 kN-m baseline; stick-slip reduced to 0.12.
lesson_learned: Barail Coal-Shale sequence produces heavy cuttings bed loading requiring continuous lubricity sweeps.

raw_narrative: Violent torque stalls up to 41 kN-m and top drive over-torque trips at 2310m. Pack-off suspected across interbedded coal stringers.
mitigation_description: Controlled back-reaming with high-viscosity pill sweep. Pumped tandem low-vis/high-vis sweep to clean cuttings bed.
outcome: Cavings cleared at shakers; hole reamed smoothly.
lesson_learned: Coal seams swell and spall when exposed to water-based mud; maintain low fluid loss (<4 cc/30min).

raw_narrative: Sudden torque spikes from 15 to 35 kN-m in Barail Coal-Shale accompanied by 15 klb overpull during connection.
mitigation_description: Washed and reamed stand twice with maximum allowable flow rate (2100 lpm). Added ester-based lubricant.
lesson_learned: Always wipe the hole prior to making connections in Barail formation.

raw_narrative: Moderate torque hunting (18-28 kN-m) and balling of PDC bit in reactive Girujan Clay at 1520m.
mitigation_description: Pumped anti-balling chemical surfactant pill and increased nozzle velocities.
outcome: ROP increased from 4 to 16 m/hr; torque stabilized at 12 kN-m.
lesson_learned: Maintain polyamine shale inhibitor concentration above 3% across Girujan Clay.

raw_narrative: Torque fluctuations of +/- 12 kN-m with audible top-drive vibration at 2350m.
mitigation_description: Decreased WOB, engaged SoftSpeed automated stick-slip mitigation algorithm.
outcome: Stick slip index dropped from 0.79 to 0.18.
lesson_learned: Use high-frequency automated stick-slip dampening when crossing Barail Coal beds.

raw_narrative: Rotary stall at 2260m. Top drive stalled out at 38 kN-m limit.
mitigation_description: Slacked off weight, worked pipe with maximum allowable pump pressure, circulated hole clean.
lesson_learned: Avoid sliding operations across brittle coal intervals.

raw_narrative: Torque erratic in swelling clay formation. Bit balling observed on surface.
mitigation_description: Circulated detergent pill, increased flow rate.
lesson_learned: Bit nozzle orientation should provide maximum hydraulic blade cleaning.

raw_narrative: Severe torsional resonance and stick-slip cycles. Torque swung between 8 and 42 kN-m.
mitigation_description: Altered rotary speed, pumped high-density weighted pill to clean out pack-off.
lesson_learned: Barail coal requires strict limits on penetration rate to avoid overloading annulus.

raw_narrative: High off-bottom torque (22 kN-m) indicating cuttings bed buildup at 2320m.
mitigation_description: Washed and back-reamed to casing shoe with tandem viscous sweeps.
outcome: Clean hole achieved; off-bottom torque dropped to 8 kN-m.
lesson_learned: Perform regular wiper trips when inclination exceeds 25 degrees.

raw_narrative: Torque peaks up to 36 kN-m observed upon entering hard brittle coal stringers at 2340m.
mitigation_description: Optimized parameters to 90 kN WOB, 130 RPM, pumped 30 bbl lubricant sweep.
lesson_learned: Pre-plan drilling parameter sweet spots based on offset well sonic log correlation.

raw_narrative: Bit torque erratic with sticky shale cutting returns.
mitigation_description: Added glycol clouding agent to water-based mud system.
lesson_learned: Glycol encapsulation prevents sticky shale buildup on BHA components.

raw_narrative: Torque spikes to 37 kN-m with stick slip index reaching 0.82 at 2370m in Barail Coal.
mitigation_description: Pumped high-viscosity pill, reduced WOB, optimized rotary speed.
outcome: Stick slip subsided; torque stabilized at 15 kN-m.
lesson_learned: Real-time telemetry vibration sensors give 15-minute early warning of impending stalls.

raw_narrative: CBL-VDL log across 13-3/8 casing shoe at 1280m showed poor bonding (amplitude > 45 mV) across washed-out Girujan Clay section. Channeling identified on ultrasonic image.
mitigation_description: Perforated casing at 1285m with 4 SPF. Performed remedial hesitation squeeze with 35 bbl microfine cement.
outcome: Pressure held at 1500 psi. Subsequent bond log confirmed hydraulic isolation (>80% bond index).
lesson_learned: Caliper log must drive standoff calculation; use positive standoff centralizers in washed out clay intervals.

raw_narrative: Top of cement (TOC) tagged 180m below programmed depth due to lost returns during slurry displacement at 2550m.
mitigation_description: Ran temperature survey and noise log to identify top of cement. Performed top-job casing annulus squeeze.
outcome: Top of cement raised to planned depth; casing shoe tested to 14.5 ppg EMW.
lesson_learned: Use low-density scavenger slurry when cementing across depleted Barail sandstone zones.

raw_narrative: Microannulus detected on 9-5/8 casing bond log at 1250m. Surface casing vent showed minor gas bubbling.
mitigation_description: Pressured up on casing to 2000 psi during re-logging to evaluate microannulus vs channeling. Applied resin squeeze.
outcome: Vent flow ceased. Acoustic bond log verified solid sheath.
lesson_learned: Allow proper WOC time (minimum 24 hrs) before testing pressure to avoid shattering green cement.

raw_narrative: Gas migration behind 9-5/8 casing following cement job. Annular gas pressure reached 350 psi at surface.
mitigation_description: Perforated squeeze holes at 2685m, pumped gas-block latex modified cement slurry with thixotropic properties.
outcome: Gas channel permanently sealed. Annulus bled to 0 psi.
lesson_learned: Gas-tight latex cement additives are mandatory across Kopili shale gas pockets.

raw_narrative: Mud contamination in lead cement slurry caused extended setting time and low compressive strength at shoe.
mitigation_description: Cleaned out soft cement, tested shoe, pumped 20 bbl microfine cement kicker pill.
outcome: Shoe tested successfully to 14.2 ppg EMW.
lesson_learned: Ensure sufficient chemical wash spacer volume (minimum 10 minutes contact time) ahead of cement.

raw_narrative: Premature slurry gelation during displacement at 2600m. Displacement halted 15 bbl early.
mitigation_description: Drilled out green cement inside casing with mill, evaluated TOC via CBL, performed remedial top squeeze.
lesson_learned: Perform pilot thickening-time tests with actual rig water and temperature simulations before every primary cement job.

raw_narrative: Loss of circulation during cement displacement. 40 bbl cement lost to formation.
mitigation_description: Spotted cement plug across loss zone and performed top annulus grout job.
lesson_learned: Include lightweight extenders and hollow glass microspheres to reduce slurry density.

raw_narrative: Casing shoe failure during formation integrity test (FIT). Leaked off at 12.8 ppg vs target 14.6 ppg.
mitigation_description: Set bridge plug, re-squeezed casing shoe with 40 bbl Class G neat cement under 1800 psi.
outcome: Re-tested FIT to 14.8 ppg EMW successfully.
lesson_learned: Always rotate and reciprocate casing during slurry displacement to prevent mud bypass channeling.

raw_narrative: Undercompaction overpressure zone in Kopili shale at 2780m. Corrected d-exponent plummeted from 1.38 to 0.94; connection gas increased to 12.5%. Flowline temperature increased by 4 deg C.
mitigation_description: Conducted flow check (negative). Weighted up active mud system from 10.4 ppg to 12.2 ppg with barite.
outcome: d-exponent trend normalized; connection gas reduced to baseline <1.5%.
lesson_learned: Continuous d-exponent trending gives 30-40m advance warning of undercompacted Kopili transition.

raw_narrative: Abrupt pore pressure ramp from 9.8 to 13.6 ppg EMW encountered at 2820m. Shakers flooded with splintery cavings. Pit gain of 8 bbl observed.
mitigation_description: Shut in well on annular preventer, recorded SIDPP=280 psi, SICP=340 psi. Circulated influx out via drillers method and increased mud weight to 13.8 ppg.
outcome: Well killed and stabilized; zero gas.
lesson_learned: Fault throw in Kopili juxtaposes normal pressured sand against high-pressure smectite shale.

raw_narrative: Pore pressure regression at top Kopili followed by sharp abnormal pressure surge to 12.9 ppg at 2800m. Trip gas on connection reached 18%.
mitigation_description: Staged mud weight increase from 10.6 to 12.5 ppg; monitored shale density log.
lesson_learned: Monitor cutting density on mud logging unit as leading pore pressure indicator.

raw_narrative: Pore pressure escalation to 13.1 ppg at 2810m. Corrected d-exponent reversed slope.
mitigation_description: Flow check confirmed static. Raised active mud weight to 12.8 ppg.
outcome: Resumed drilling under safe 0.5 ppg overbalance.
lesson_learned: Use real-time LWD resistivity and acoustic velocity to predict pore pressure ahead of bit.

raw_narrative: Severe overpressured gas-charged shale pocket at 2830m. Background gas surged to 32% with rapid drilling break.
mitigation_description: Flow check positive. Shut in well, increased mud weight from 11.0 to 13.5 ppg through choke manifold.
outcome: Gas safely circulated out; well stabilized.
lesson_learned: Always perform flow check immediately upon drilling breaks in Kopili shale.

raw_narrative: Pore pressure ramped from 10.2 to 12.8 ppg at 2850m. Annular pressure while drilling (APWD) confirmed tight margin.
mitigation_description: Raised mud weight to 12.6 ppg; reduced pump rate to control ECD below fracture limit.
outcome: Hole in balance with zero influx.
lesson_learned: APWD tool gives indispensable insight into narrow drilling windows.

raw_narrative: Drill string parted at 2420m following severe pack-off and torque spike. Left BHA (6-1/2 drill collars, MWD/LWD, 8-1/2 PDC bit) in hole. Top of fish at 2420m, bottom at 2485m (fish length 65m).
mitigation_description: POOH with upper string. Made up Bowen Series 150 overshot with 7-7/8 spiral grapple, fishing bumper sub, and hydraulic fishing jar. Ran in hole, tagged top of fish at 2420.5m. Engaged fish, jarred upward for 45 minutes with 120 klbs overpull.
outcome: Fish jarred free. Circulated clean and pulled out of hole. 100% fish recovered including bit and MWD sensors.
lesson_learned: Inspect all drill collar connections with ultrasonic phased array before drilling high-vibration coal sections.

raw_narrative: Twist-off of 5-inch heavy-weight drill pipe (HWDP) during back-reaming tight hole in swelling Girujan Clay at 1640m. Fish top at 1640m.
mitigation_description: Ran in hole with cut-lip guide overshot and hydraulic jar. Engaged fish on first attempt. Jarred fish free with 70 klb upward pull.
lesson_learned: Limit back-reaming overpull to 60% of pipe yield in dogleg sections.

raw_narrative: Mechanical stuck pipe resulted in parting of drill pipe at 2920m while attempting to work string free in Kopili shale.
mitigation_description: Washed over top 15m of fish with 8-1/8 washpipe. Latched with overshot and jarred continuously while pumping high-lubricity pipe-release pill.
outcome: Fish freed after 3.5 hours of jarring. Complete BHA recovered to surface.
lesson_learned: When differential or mechanical sticking occurs in shale, spot oil/glycol release pill immediately before excessive overpull.

raw_narrative: Lost 3 roller cone cutter cones and bit shank in hole at 2150m in abrasive Barail Sandstone.
mitigation_description: Ran 7-5/8 junk basket and permanent fishing magnet. Circulated reverse to sweep junk into basket.
outcome: Recovered 3 cutter cones, bearings, and 12 kg metal debris. Hole clean for new PDC bit.
lesson_learned: Monitor bit torque and hours closely in abrasive sandstone; pull bit before bearing failure.

raw_narrative: Motor failure and parted drill string at 2410m during rotary steerable motor run.
mitigation_description: RIH with fishing BHA: overshot, accelerator, jars. Latched fish and jarred free.
lesson_learned: Monitor motor differential pressure; do not exceed manufacturer torque rating in interbedded formations.

raw_narrative: Dropped survey tool / slickline memory gauge in hole at 1720m.
mitigation_description: Ran wireline fishing spear and center spear grab.
outcome: Caught wireline and retrieved survey instrument intact.
lesson_learned: Double check rope socket clamp torque prior to downhole tool deployment.

raw_narrative: String parted inside 9-5/8 casing shoe at 2480m due to fatigue crack on 4-1/2 IF tool joint.
mitigation_description: Dressed top of fish with flat bottom mill. Latched with spiral grapple overshot. Jarred with 140 klb overpull.
outcome: Fish freed and pulled to surface.
lesson_learned: Rotate drill pipe stands to avoid continuous localized cyclic bending stress at casing shoe.

raw_narrative: Parted drill collars at 2510m following key-seat sticking during POOH.
mitigation_description: Ran wall hook to center fish in hole, engaged with overshot, fired hydraulic jar.
lesson_learned: Run key-seat wiper sub above BHA when drilling doglegs greater than 3 deg/30m.
